Class SpriteManager

java.lang.Object
utils.SpriteManager
public final class SpriteManager extends Object
Centralised, JAR-safe image loader with an in-memory cache.

Why this class exists

new Image("path/to/file.png") resolves the path through the JavaFX thread context class loader using a relative URL. This works in the IDE but silently fails inside a packaged modular JAR because the classpath root is no longer accessible via a file URL.

This class uses Class.getResourceAsStream(String) with an absolute classpath path (prefixed with /) instead, which is guaranteed to work in every launch mode — IDE run, fat JAR, modular JAR.

Cache

Loaded images are stored in a HashMap keyed by their resource path. Subsequent calls with the same path return the cached instance, avoiding repeated disk / classpath I/O.

Usage


 Image icon = SpriteManager.loadImage("character/icon/gojoIcon.png");

  • Method Details

    • loadImage

      public static javafx.scene.image.Image loadImage(String path)
      Loads an image from the classpath, or returns the cached copy if it was already loaded.

      The path may be relative (e.g. "enemy/slime.png") or absolute (e.g. "/enemy/slime.png"); a leading / is added automatically if missing.

      If the resource cannot be found, an error is printed to stderr and null is returned — callers that draw with a null image will simply skip the draw call (JavaFX ignores null images).

      Parameters:
      path - classpath-relative path to the image resource
      Returns:
      the loaded Image, or null if the resource was not found
